text:
- Total revenue across all products was £20,428.39 TW, representing a decline of 13.3% WoW from £23,564.33 LW, though this reflects a strong performance of +40.6% YoY.

- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER dominated sales as rank 1 product with revenue of £3,804.27 TW, capturing 18.6% of total revenue TW and growing +52.1% WoW.

- PARTY BUNTING held rank 2 with revenue of £1,840.12 TW and 9.0% share TW, but declined sharply by 47.2% WoW despite recording the most orders at 35 TW versus 55 LW.

- PAPER CHAIN KIT EMPIRE achieved rank 3 status with revenue of £1,266.57 TW representing 6.2% of total revenue TW and posted a modest gain of +16.3% WoW.

- CERAMIC STRAWBERRY MONEY BOX experienced the largest WoW increase at +11249.0%, with revenue surging from £8.26 LW to £937.43 TW.

- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER suffered the largest WoW decrease of 83.1%, falling from £6,087.56 LW to £1,028.01 TW.

- UNION STRIPE WITH FRINGE HAMMOCK showed the strongest YoY growth at +729.0%, reaching £87.45 LY.

- ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT recorded the largest YoY decline at 70.9%, dropping from £1,512.31 LY.
